publisher: Village Preservation, East Village Building Blocks
method: Individual visual inspection of the linked primary photographs and architectural profiles; municipal BIN/BBL joins reviewed for shared parcels. Dimensions and unseen elevations remain estimates. Story schedules describe the street elevation; exposed basements are modeled separately where recorded. They are not a legal occupancy or floor-area survey.
rights: Photographs were inspected in temporary storage only. No photograph or derived facade texture is redistributed.
